(3) A man wearing a red hoodie and glasses is shown from the chest up. He mimics the receiving fist gesture and then points his finger towards the lens. (4) A brief shot of a woman with long brown hair and clear, glowing skin is shown smiling gently towards the camera. (5) A woman with long black hair wearing a bright red cardigan appears. She holds a small microphone and makes the same receiving fist gesture. (6) A man in a dark maroon shirt is shown performing the receiving gesture with a smile. (7) A woman with short dark hair and glasses wearing a dark patterned shawl waves and then makes the fist gesture. (8) A woman with long hair, bangs, and glasses wearing a pink top speaks while gesturing with her hands. (9) High-quality close-up shots of white and gold cosmetic bottles labeled 'DRX' are displayed on a clean white surface. (10) A final static white background with gray text displays the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone numbers, and addresses.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for DRX Dermatology Clinic, timed for the Chinese New Year. It uses a series of fast-paced, high-arousal clips where different clinic staff members participate in a 'Receive' (接) challenge. Each segment uses reverse psychology, telling viewers not to click if they don't want positive skincare results (like getting rid of wrinkles or dark circles), ultimately highlighting the clinic's effectiveness and expertise while inviting consultation.
